item.title: Aera Workspaces
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Empowering End Users with Self-Service Decision Intelligence

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Empowering End Users with Self-Service Decision Intelligence

Aera Workspaces brings a powerful, collaborative environment where users can seamlessly create, manage, and execute business models. This feature is designed to empower decision-makers with enhanced control over their data and insights. Workspaces puts advanced simulation and action capabilities directly into the hands of end users, transforming how they plan, simulate, and act on business decisions.

- __Calc Engine for Advanced Simulations:__ A multi-dimensional modeling engine that enables real-time scenario planning. Users can simulate complex business scenarios with zero lag, using up-to-date live data for accurate, strategic decisions. - __Direct Action Initiation:__ Move beyond recommendations—users can now directly execute actions within the workspace with a single click, accelerating the decision-to-action process. - __Self-Service Modeling:__ Build models independently without needing advanced technical expertise. The intuitive, Excel-like interface allows users to modify and adjust models on the go, empowering them to drive decisions with agility.

- __Real-Time Data & Simulations:__ Leverage real-time data to run what-if scenarios and quickly adjust to changing business conditions. - __User-Friendly Control:__ Easily accessible modeling capabilities mean users no longer need to rely on technical teams to build or adjust models. - __AI-Enhanced Insights:__ Continuous feedback from AI-driven models keeps decisions current, enabling better outcomes with every interaction.
Aera Workspaces brings a powerful, collaborative environment where users can seamlessly create, manage, and execute business models.

item.title: Agentic Ambient Orchestration
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Activate and manage autonomous agents to streamline complex decision processes.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Activate and manage autonomous agents to streamline complex decision processes.

With Agentic Ambient Orchestration, you gain new levels of speed and agility in decision-making. You can blend structured and unstructured data, your expertise, and the reasoning power of large language models (LLMs) — all to build richer decision context and unlock broader use cases. From the frontlines to the back office, you can activate AI agents and create [Aera Skills™](https://www.aeratechnology.com/skills) using natural language prompting. Because Aera enables you to create decision flows with embedded agents, your role shifts from analyzing data to designing decision automation and guiding its execution. With that shift, you can focus your time and expertise on where it matters most.

• AI agents embedded in decision flows
    Quickly build Aera Skills™ using embedded AI agents that follow natural language prompts to reason and take action. Built-in guardrails ensure every step stays transparent, accountable, and well-governed.
  • Any data, any format
    Aera can work with both structured and unstructured data — from transactional systems to PDFs and emails — to power complex processes like claims management, procurement negotiations, and contract compliance.
  • Flexible LLM integration
    The platform lets you easily and securely configure and manage connections to large language models (LLMs), which Aera can then leverage to reason, furnish insights, and generate content dynamically.

• Rapid Skill creation — from coding to oversight
    Define decision intent using natural language, eliminating technical barriers to creating decision flows. Agentic AI takes it from there — reasoning through the problem and generating the decision logic to match, so you get to value faster.
  • Autonomous, scalable collaboration
    Automate communication and coordination across people, systems, and vendors, such as negotiating order changes with vendors.
  • Faster time-to-action
    Get faster and more precise outcomes with the help of decision trigger detection, alternative simulations, and autonomous actions.

Aera's Agentic Ambient Orchestration is a game-changing capability that extends across the entire platform, enhancing decision-making processes with intelligent automation, natural language interactions, and seamless engagement.

item.title: Decision Engines
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Automate and optimize decisions across the full spectrum of decision-making.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Automate and optimize decisions across the full spectrum of decision-making.

Aera Decision Cloud™ contains a comprehensive set of interconnected engines built to support all types of decisions. Together, these engines deliver the intelligence and precision to drive business decisions at scale. Analytics, modeling, optimization, and machine learning are seamlessly orchestrated into explainable, efficient decision flows. Whether you're calculating available-to-promise inventory, simulating complex scenarios, or optimizing trade-offs, Aera applies the right engine to each decision — no black boxes, no silos, and fully auditable decision logic embedded in every step.

• Low-code decision modeling
    Using the drag-and-drop Process Builder, you can combine engines and define logic with a visual, low-code interface that’s easy to use.
  • Business rules guardrails
    Set clear rules to guide when and how certain actions should be automated. With defined thresholds, Aera Skills can move decisions forward or trigger processes automatically.
  • Agent-ready orchestration
    All engines are natively accessible by AI agents, so they can reason, act, and make decisions on their own — without waiting for manual input.

• Right engine for the right decision
    Select from a wide range of engines — analytical SQL, scenario modeling, optimization, and machine learning — so every decision uses the method (or mix of methods) that fits best.
  • Explainable, auditable logic
    Every recommendation is fully traceable to the data, model, and logic behind it — giving you transparency and building trust with users, approvers, and auditors.
  • Continuous improvement at scale
    Built-in learning and feedback loops help your decisions get smarter over time as conditions, data, and outcomes evolve.
Automate and optimize decisions across the full spectrum of decision-making.

item.title: Data Workbench™
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Transform and process billions of rows of data into a unified decision data model

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Transform and process billions of rows of data into a unified decision data model

Data Workbench enables you to access internal and external data, refine, harmonize, and publish readily consumable data in the Decision Data Model. With Data Workbench, you can leverage predefined content from a rich library of crawlers and data models and adapt them to your environment, extend them or create new content to build the Decision Data Model.

- Domain-specific calculations and scripts run automatically to populate an algorithmic library of business data models, key metrics, dimensions, and metadata. It provides embedded domain expertise not available in enterprise transactional systems or data lakes. - Information is processed and enriched at the most granular level, enabling analysis of enterprise data at any level of detail, from high-level KPIs to transactional data points. - A columnar database stores all processed data, allowing users to “zoom” in and out of the data set on the fly. - Aera’s patented depth-first processing orchestrates the data refinement and enrichment specific to the type and subject of the data being processed. Complete data visibility and traceability are possible at each node of the data processing journey, ensuring accurate and complete data.

- __Data Harmonization:__ With Data Workbench, you can model the sequence of business processes and orchestrate data transformation accordingly, from cleansing and deduplication of data to correlating and linking each new record with existing records in the system to harmonize data. - __Context for decision making:__ Measures and key metrics, such as Inventory Turns, OTIF, and Cycle Time are available out of the box. Real-time augmented and automated decision-making is achievable by providing context for business data models that populate the Decision Data Model. - __Explainable models at scale:__ By leveraging Aera’s patented Depth-First Processing technology, Data Workbench can model complex relationships in millions of rows of transactional data, regardless of data volume.
Transform and process billions of rows of data into a unified decision data model

item.title: Aera Control Room
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Centralized Command for Enhanced Decision Intelligence

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Centralized Command for Enhanced Decision Intelligence

The Aera Control Room serves as the central command center within the Aera Decision Cloud™, offering administrators and decision architects a comprehensive, real-time view of the entire decision intelligence network. This platform provides full visibility across data crawlers, processes, data science workflows, users, and, most critically, both structured and situational decisions. By proactively monitoring activities and issuing notifications when issues arise, the Control Room ensures that administrators and decision architects have complete oversight of every job and its status. This includes tracking user activity, identifying which insights are actively utilized, and monitoring data storage. For decision architects, understanding the performance of Aera Skills™ and user interactions is essential for continuously improving decision-making throughout the organization. The Control Room enables tracking of recommendations, assessment of automation levels, and measurement of impact, empowering decision architects to refine processes and enhance system responsiveness over time. This holistic approach cultivates a fully integrated, adaptive network that drives smarter business at every level.

- __Real-Time Dashboards:__ Access intuitive dashboards displaying live data on processes, workflows, and decision statuses. - __User Activity Tracking:__ Monitor user engagement and identify which insights are actively used, facilitating better resource allocation and training. - __Data Storage Monitoring:__ Keep track of data storage metrics to ensure optimal performance and compliance with data governance policies. - __Recommendation Tracking:__ Analyze the lifecycle of recommendations, from generation to execution, to assess effectiveness and areas for improvement. - __Automation Assessment:__ Evaluate the levels of automation within decision processes to identify opportunities for increased efficiency. - __Impact Measurement:__ Quantify the outcomes of decisions to understand their impact on business objectives and inform future strategies.

- __Comprehensive Visibility:__ Gain a real-time, holistic view of all decision-making activities across the enterprise, ensuring transparency and informed oversight. - __Proactive Monitoring:__ Receive immediate notifications of any issues, allowing for swift corrective actions to maintain seamless operations. - __Enhanced Decision-Making:__ Leverage insights into user interactions and Aera Skills™ performance to continuously refine and improve decision processes.
The Aera Control Room serves as the central command center within the Aera Decision Cloud™.

item.title: Aera Inbox
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: View, explore, and act on data-driven recommendations

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: View, explore, and act on data-driven recommendations

Aera Inbox is an intuitive interface within Aera Decision Cloud™ that delivers prioritized and personalized recommendations for each user within your organization. As Aera Skills™ process data, apply intelligence, and identify opportunities, Aera Inbox delivers Aera’s recommendations to users in real time. Users can easily understand each recommendation’s context, evaluate trade-offs with powerful analytics, and take immediate action. Aera Inbox also keeps a complete record of all the decisions made – that is, whether each recommendation was accepted, modified, or rejected – and stores that information in the Decision Data Model™. Capturing information about every decision allows relevant Aera Skills to learn and improve continuously over time, while also revealing opportunities to automate decisions for increased agility.

- Sort and prioritize recommendations by a variety of facets, including importance, financial impact, and urgency. - User-configurable interface can be personalized by role, responsibility, and user preferences. - Prescriptive, time-sensitive, and contextual recommendations present the impact of decisions and guidance for users - Transparent “glass box” AI shows you how each recommendation is calculated, from the predictive analytics to the machine learning algorithms used for forecasting.

- __Easily explainable recommendations:__ Each recommendation provides the best course of action from among available options analyzed by AI, allowing users to accept, modify, or reject the recommendation as circumstances demand. This explainability increases users’ trust in Decision Intelligence and leads to increased adoption. - __View each recommendation’s projected impact:__ Each recommendation includes a summary of projected impact in terms of revenue, cost, and units – with the option to view a detailed analysis of how this impact is calculated. This transparency allows users to explore options, evaluate impacts, and weigh trade-offs before making a decision. - __Rapid execution:__ Once a decision is made, Aera can write changes back into your transactional systems of record in order to execute the decision at the moment of maximum impact. - __Continuous learning and improvement:__ Aera Inbox captures users’ end-to-end activity including the steps that were completed while rejecting or accepting recommendations. Aera continuously learns from this audit trail in order to improve recommendations over time.
View, explore, and act on data-driven recommendations

item.title: Decision Data Model™
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Fully aggregated, harmonized data from across your enterprise

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Fully aggregated, harmonized data from across your enterprise

The Aera Decision Data Model (DDM) is designed to drastically reduce the time and effort spent on data wrangling. This innovative approach provides fully aggregated, harmonized, and labeled datasets, available right down to the transaction level for training models. Data available via the DDM is automatically refreshed in near-real-time – made possible by Aera’s patented Data Crawler technology and internet-scale data architecture. Every decision made in Aera Decision Cloud is recorded in the DDM, along with the context in which the decision was made, a record of actions taken, and the resulting outcome. This complete audit trail enables real-time monitoring of decisions across your enterprise. It also forms the foundation for Aera’s learning capabilities, enabling Aera Skills to improve with each user interaction and adapt to your ever-changing business environment.

- Provides a self-service interface and the full set of tools to: 1. Create Data Crawlers 2. Create data sets 3. Create dimensions 4. Create Subject Areas in the Aera data model 5. Create data streams 6. Create extraction schedules and jobs 7. Work with predefined Subjects in the Aera data model 8. Publish content for other teams to use 9. Monitor for errors - The Decision Data Model Is the master repository of your enterprise, represented in a single data model, fed by real-time data streams with thousands of predefined data sets available in the following major subject areas: 1. Master Data 2. Finance 3. Purchasing 4. Production 5. Quality 6. Inventory 7. Sales and Shipments 8. Warehouse 9. Customer Management 10. Custom Data Sets - __Low System Impact:__ Delivers high performance multi-node processing and extraction scheduling to deliver high performance with minimal impact on underlying systems. - __Touchless Monitoring:__ Aera monitors day-to-day data flows and proactively recommends solutions to issues that arise so you can focus on the rest of the business.

- __Real-time enterprise visibility:__ The Decision Data Model provides a unified view of your enterprise, aggregating and harmonizing data from disparate systems into a single data model. - __External information in context:__ The Decision Data Model provides the flexibility to incorporate external and physical data, from IoT sensor data to point-of-sale data and real-time weather information, to ensure decisions are made within the right context. - __Open architecture:__ Using Aera’s Data API, enriched and refined data in the DDM can be accessed by enterprise data lakes, data warehouses, and other third-party enterprise applications. - __No more data wrangling:__ By making it easy to access aggregated and harmonized data, your data scientists will be able to spend more time operationalizing AI/ML models.
Fully aggregated, harmonized data from across your enterprise

item.title: Aera Cortex™
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Develop, train, and operationalize AI and machine learning models for decision making

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Develop, train, and operationalize AI and machine learning models for decision making

Aera Cortex™ is the AI engine purpose-built to enable Decision Intelligence, allowing you to operationalize AI in a business decision-making context. Aera Cortex is an open ModelOps platform where you can build your own or leverage models built and trained elsewhere. Cortex offers direct integration to live data sets, domain-specific algorithms, optimization techniques, and the ability to leverage data science models built anywhere. This gives your business the flexibility to use off-the-shelf AI/ML models, customized and tuned to your needs, or to bring and manage your own models. With Aera Cortex, users can build plans, run scenarios, and automate previously manual decisions with flexibility – and without in-depth knowledge of coding. Aera Cortex gives you the ability to create and customize ML models at any level, along with the tools to monitor their application, and a rich set of tools to improve them over time. Aera Cortex allows your business to leverage the full power of AI to digitize and automate critical business decisions.

- Fully-harmonized training data sets available at your fingertips - Comprehensive MLOps / ModelOps platform to build, train, and maintain models or leverage models built elsewhere - Automated model training infrastructure with built-in AutoML and Auto Forecast - Automatically learns from decisions made and improves outcomes with Confidence Scoring

- __No more data wrangling:__ Because Cortex connects directly to the Aera Decision Data Model™, data scientists always have access to the most up-to-date data - __Operationalize your models:__ Aera Cortex makes models available within a decision-making context, and allows you to maximize your investment in existing models trained in other MLOps tools - __Continuous learning:__ Leverages the full context of decisions made and their impacts to improve future recommendations - __Purpose-built for Decision Intelligence:__ Aera Cortex is designed to deliver the intelligence needed to digitize, augment, and automate decision making at scale

item.title: Business Rules
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: Operationalize and manage decision automation rules

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Operationalize and manage decision automation rules

Business Rules allow you to accelerate decision-making processes by digitizing decision logic within Aera Skills™. These automation rules are flexible enough to address a wide range of conditions, from localization and organizational rules to category- and product-level factors. Create as many rules, conditions, sub-conditions, and actions as you need to fit your specific requirements. Business rules can be localized for particular regions, facilities, or products – users can even create different rules for different conditions on the same product. With a visual representation to provide a palette of business data, actions, and events, these rules are automatically layered onto the Skill to determine what actions will take place in any scenario.

- Layer automation rules on top of Aera Skills, guiding the system on when to automate certain activities. With defined thresholds, Skills can progress through processes or make decisions based on user-defined thresholds, only asking for user intervention when defined thresholds are met. - Rules can be triggered in multiple ways as your organization requires – on demand, on a schedule, or whenever requested by a process.

- __Digitize complex business policies:__ As you build trust in Aera’s recommendations, you can define business rules so that routine or high-confidence decisions can be executed automatically. - __No complex technical knowledge needed:__ Business Rules are designed for non-technical users, with a low-code graphical environment for intuitive process design that’s accessible to those with limited coding experience.
Operationalize and manage decision automation rules.

item.title: Decision Board
